metadata.title: Pahala/Salepur - Rosgulla district of Odisha
metadata.description:
Delhi Food Walks went all the way to Pahala and Salepur to understand the history and the preparations of Rosgulla. It was interesting to observe the step by step preparations of rosgulla. To read more about our culinary journey in Cuttack, please read the blog- http://blog.delhifoodwalks.com/cuttack-land-of-aloo-dum-dahi-bara/

About Anubhav Sapra :

Anubhav Sapra is an avid foodie! He is a Founder but proudly calls himself a Foodie-in-chief at Delhi Food Walks. He is also a street-food and Indian regional cuisine connoisseur and loves to write about street-food.

Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed! Thank you for watching!
